items.question: What does a SaaS SEO agency do?
items.answer: A SaaS SEO agency gets your software found by buyers who search, and turns those visits into trials and demos. At LoudFace that means comparison, alternatives and use-case pages, technical fixes, and SEO and AEO work so ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews name you. Conversion work runs alongside, so the traffic turns into pipeline.

items.question: How much does a SaaS SEO agency cost?
items.answer: LoudFace engagements start from $5k a month, scoped on the intro call, with a fixed monthly proposal and kickoff within 48 hours of signature. The full breakdown is on our pricing page. For what other agencies charge, see our B2B SaaS SEO and AEO retainer cost guide.

items.question: How long does SaaS SEO take to show results?
items.answer: It moves at different speeds. You see shipped work within five days. A first AI citation can land within a day on a low-competition question: Pond was cited by ChatGPT one day after publishing. A steady place in AI answers takes weeks, and top rankings on competitive terms take months.

items.question: What is the difference between SEO and AEO for SaaS?
items.answer: SEO earns your pages a place in Google's results. AEO, also called GEO, gets your brand named inside the answers ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews give. Google says there are no special optimizations needed for its AI features, so strong SEO is the base. AEO adds the formats and the third-party mentions each engine reads.

items.question: Why does AI search matter for B2B SaaS?
items.answer: Your buyers use it to shortlist vendors. G2 found that 51% of B2B software buyers start research with an AI chatbot more often than with Google. Forrester found 89% of buyers used generative AI in at least one area of their purchasing process in 2024. If the answer names your competitors and not you, you are off the shortlist before the first call.

items.question: How do you measure SaaS SEO success?
items.answer: Against revenue. We track rankings, clicks, impressions, AI visibility and citations, and read each one against signups, booked demos and other leads. AI visibility is reported engine by engine, because ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews read different sources. You can check what has shipped on a live Scoreboard at any time, and a written summary arrives every Friday.

items.question: Does JavaScript still hurt SaaS SEO?
items.answer: It can slow things down. Google queues pages for rendering, and its own docs say a page may wait a few seconds or longer. Google still recommends server-side or pre-rendering, because not all bots can run JavaScript. We check what search engines and AI crawlers actually see on your marketing pages.

items.question: Do we need to manage the work?
items.answer: No. One point of contact at LoudFace owns the roadmap across SEO, AEO and conversion. You get a 30-minute weekly check-in and a written Friday summary covering what shipped, how the numbers moved and what comes next. Decisions come to you only on pricing, positioning and what to ship next quarter. You approve the work, and we ship it.
